name: nidhi
bio: Final-year CS student who accidentally became an ML engineer. I build things that probably shouldn't work but somehow do — from post-quantum crypto scanners to delivery route optimizers. Currently interning at Infor, mass-applying to jobs, and learning way too many programming languages at once.

roles.label: hire me pls
roles.detail: Hyderabad · remote · will relocate for good coffee

now.text: week 1 of 9 — grinding 15 LeetCode problems, rewriting my resume for the 47th time, applying to 3 jobs a day, and somehow also learning ALGOL & SQL for a 7-languages challenge I voluntarily signed up for.

projects.title: QSecure
projects.desc: A scanner that finds quantum-vulnerable crypto in your codebase and migrates it to post-quantum algorithms. Because future-me shouldn't have to deal with that.

projects.title: RouteGenie
projects.desc: Delivery route optimizer with a Flutter app, FastAPI backend, and way too many analytics dashboards. It calculates time, fuel, and traffic so drivers don't have to.

projects.title: WE Arcade
projects.desc: Ran a GitHub org where 100+ people built browser games together. My job was mostly saying 'please write tests' and 'that's not how you do a code review.'

projects.title: SconeVision
projects.desc: An MLOps pipeline on AWS that classifies delivery vehicles in real-time. SageMaker, Step Functions, the whole circus. 97.68% accuracy — the 2.32% keeps me humble.

projects.title: Arrhythmia Detection
projects.desc: Teaching a neural network to read heartbeats better than I can. ResNet + BiLSTM + Attention for 61-class ECG classification. Still ongoing, still debugging.

projects.title: Smart India Hackathon — Top 5
projects.desc: Built an OCR system to digitize government documents that scanners couldn't read. Placed top 5 nationally, which was cool until I realized there's no prize money.
